summary: Enhance your career with our Property Valuation and Appraisal Training Course. Gain essential skills and knowledge to excel in the real estate industry.
lede: Property appraisal training covers how market evidence, appraisal methods and financial analysis inform a property’s value. It is for real estate, banking and investment professionals who need to produce defensible property valuations. Learners practise identifying and adjusting comparable properties, applying sales comparison and income approaches with cap-rate and net operating income calculations, and communicating findings in appraisal reports.

Commercial Broker: Provide valuation insights to support

Mortgage Underwriter: Verify property value to ensure

modules: Legal and Ethical Frameworks in Appraisal
Financial and Economic Analysis for Valuation
Legal and Zoning Considerations in Appraisal

prerequisites: No formal prerequisites are required. A working knowledge of basic math and Excel is recommended. Bring a laptop with Excel installed for hands-on exercises. No coding or advanced finance preparation is needed.
